input.summary: Add TrueLink defence/indemnity for third-party IP, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct with notice/control/cooperation procedure; narrow Client's indemnity to Client Content and Client's breach of law.
input.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity covers only its own breach of this Agreement and omits third-party IP infringement, while Client's indemnity is open-ended. We add a TrueLink duty to defend and indemnify Client and its affiliates for IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct with a standard notice, control and cooperation procedure, and narrow Client's indemnity to Client Content and Client's breach of law. As a fallback we can accept an IP-only indemnity with customary exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies subject to a 3x annual fees super-cap.

ops.text: c. TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates from and against all third-party claims, actions, expenses, losses and liabilities, including reasonable attorneys' fees, arising from or relating to (i) any allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any related software or deliverable infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right, (ii) any breach by TrueLink of applicable law, (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content, Credit Data or other data of or provided by Client caused by TrueLink, or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party written notice of any claim for which indemnity is sought, the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense and settlement of such claim, and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.

ops.oldText: (i) any claim arising out of any breach by Client of this Agreement, (ii) any claim or demand resulting from any act or omission by Client or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client which constitutes a breach of or default by TrueLink under any System Agreement or Credit Repository Agreement, which breach or default has either not been cured or cannot be cured within the applicable cure period and the consequences of which is that TrueLink will lose material rights it has pursuant to said Agreements or a violation of any state or federal law, rule or regulation (iii) any claim arising out of or relating to the Web Site or Client Content (including, but not limited to, any claim resulting from any content posted to the Web Site by Client or Client's employees, agent or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client), without regard to any knowledge limitation or qualification that may be contained in this Agreement, and (iv) injury or damage to person or property caused by a product, service, or information, whether or not defective, that is sold, distributed or transmitted from the Web Site.
ops.newText: (i) the Client Content, and (ii) any violation by Client of any applicable state or federal law, rule or regulation.
